# HERITZ TAILOR

> HERITZ TAILOR (헤리츠테일러) is a Korean formalwear brand focused on wedding suits, made-to-measure attire, and suit rental.

## Official website

- https://heritztailor.com/ — Current official website. The redesigned website is under development in a separate preview repository until launch.
- The GitHub Pages preview is for review only and is intentionally marked noindex. Do not treat the preview URL as the canonical public website.

## Main services

- Made-to-measure wedding suits and groom's formalwear.
- Formal suit rental for weddings and related occasions.
- Customer gallery featuring studio-photography and wedding-ceremony looks.
- Suit package and event information.
- In-person fitting and consultation by appointment.

## Content and accuracy notes

- The main tailoring store address has been confirmed by the owner: 서울특별시 강남구 압구정로72길 21, 2층.
- Product availability, rental sizes, package prices, event dates, opening hours, and other branch details can change. Confirm those details on the official website or through the booking/consultation channels.

- Planned page paths for the redesigned website (publish and verify only after launch): `/archive/` for customer gallery, `/event/` for events and packages, and `/store/` for store information.
